item.title: FHP I-110 Operation Leads To 8 DUI, 3 Super Speed Arrests, Citations
item.description: Over the Thanksgiving weekend, the Florida Highway Patrol conducted an enforcement operation on I-110. Troopers from the Pensacola District targeted DUI offenses and aggressive driving. The operation resulted in eight DUI arrests, five criminal arrests, three “super speeder” arrests, and 10 traffic citations. Photo courtesy FHP for NorthEscambia.com, click to enlarge.
